meta_description: Larian Jambatan Sultan Nazrin Shah 2026 (LJSN26): October 25 in Bagan Datuk, Perak. 21K, 10K, 5K from MPTI — a Malaysian bridge run reviewed.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026 in Bagan Datuk, Perak, this MPTI-organised bridge run offers three distances. A local-government-backed race across one of Perak's landmark bridges.
verdict: Larian Jambatan Sultan Nazrin Shah (LJSN26) is a local-government-organised bridge run in Bagan Datuk, Perak — a coastal district in southwestern Perak that's investing in sports tourism. Organised by Majlis Perbandaran Teluk Intan (MPTI), the race offers three distances (21K, 10K, 5K). The Sultan Nazrin Shah Bridge — a major Perak infrastructure project — provides the course's defining feature. Registration isn't open yet, but for runners wanting a unique Malaysian bridge-race experience in an under-represented part of Perak, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: The Bridge: Sultan Nazrin Shah
paragraphs: The Sultan Nazrin Shah Bridge is one of Perak's landmark infrastructure projects, connecting Bagan Datuk to the wider coastal region. [1] A race across it offers a distinctive bridge-crossing experience with views over the Perak River estuary. October in Perak is the inter-monsoon period, with manageable morning conditions.
